//: type-scale.test.ts is the only test in this repo that reads outside its own package: it walks apps/site/src and apps/web/src to enforce one scale across both registers. Turbo's default cache key for this package covers packages/ui alone, so a violation committed in an app did not move the key and the last pass replayed from cache — the gate reported green through two commits that had broken it. Naming the directories the test actually reads keeps the caching and fixes the key.
